sop.authority: Explicit user instruction to promote all reusable, non-project-specific calibrated parameters into current SOP. User-selected execution defaults, not empirical validation.
sop.scope: New or materially reopened Malaysian residential underwriting; lifecycle and operating-form applicability must be declared.
sop.schema: Declarative SOP parameter register, not a drop-in input for historical case models. Future adapters must map fields explicitly and validate results.
sop.precedence: Frozen Core and G0-G9 unchanged. This version supersedes conflicting inherited financial presets for future work only; evidence-supported actual terms are shown separately.

standard.launch_debt_basis: Gross contracted price reference; actual lender valuation and rebate treatment verified separately.
standard.resale_debt_basis: Agreed acquisition price reference; actual valuation/LTV separately.
standard.yield_basis: Effective nett consideration excluding unreceived or conditional incentives.
standard.coverage: Monthly parcel rent less full principal-and-interest instalment less management fee; identify combined sinking charges.

base.amortisation_start_convention: Handover for construction-period interest-only planning; actual lender maturity separately.
base.unknown_cost_residual: U, separately disclosed, never asserted zero.
base.cashflow_timing: Monthly event ledger; actual fee/payment dates where available.

targets.status: User-selected target scenario, not verified forecast, guaranteed floor or automatic investment pass.

S1.timing: At handover for planning base; first-draw bound for new launches. Existing holdings: at stress start.

S3.applies_to: Actual acquisition financing or future resale buyer as applicable; keep separate from seller sale price.

S4.example_base48_total60: Translate approved delay to case-specific completion baseline; 60 is not a universal construction period.

S8.timing: One initial crisis lease-up; persistent two-month replacement void shown separately as duration bound.

S9.risk: One income component at zero for the entire hold

S10.risk: Entire first operating year at zero

S11.risk: First year with only six paid months

S16.basis: Original effective nett entry, not target exit

S18.seller_costs: Itemised; no arbitrary blanket extra charge.

S21.J3: Union of J1 and J2; no duplicate charges, added arrears, term shock or deleted stresses.

S22.risk: Synthetic portfolio cash/reserve preset; actual portfolio review retained

S23.method: Test supported ordinary whole-parcel fallback for split operation; no invented rent or conversion saving.

S24.scope: Each income stream separately and synchronous bound when applicable.

required_case_inputs: Rent per supported operating stream and evidence status
Current applicable fee/tax schedules and buyer/seller profile
Unknown cost residual and payment timing
sop.override_protocol: Retain standard comparison; show authenticated terms and scoped sensitivities separately. Record reason, evidence, old/new value and affected results. Never silently tune to a favourable result.
not_promoted: Project identity, specific layouts and split rents
10% rebate and zero deposit as universal terms
Specific source asking prices, fee invoices/quotes and project ranking

fee_reference.legal_route: Ordinary resale Table A, undiscounted; no HDA discounts
fee_reference.duty_basis: Ordinary Malaysian individual, no exemption assumed; consideration used provisionally as assessed value. Not a personal tax determination.
fee_reference.remaining: Unquoted disbursements, owner bills, insurance, rates, actual title-release alternatives and duties/fees differing from reference remain U.
fee_reference.revalidation_limit: SRO2023 and Customs rate background accessed16October2026. Current HASiL indexed guideline/2024 Act links failed404. Ordinary sub-RM1m transfer/loan scales retained as provisional reference from accessible2014 Act, not complete current exemption/profile verification.

original_case.name: Eve Suite compact
original_case.source_note: Sale is fully furnished, one bay, header 1+1 versus body 1BR. Historical product record calls 680-sf stock studios. Base rent is an asking-informed whole-unit assumption, not a signed lease.
original_case.mechanism: A lower entry quantum may monetise Ara accessibility for small households without family-sized acquisition cost.
original_case.buyer: Primary resale underwriting is investor-led. Single/couple owner adoption is possible but unmeasured. Pacific Place 864-sf two-bedroom and Eve 1065-sf two-bedroom compete on different space/price tradeoffs.
original_case.project: Historic studio-heavy mix increases correlated small-unit competition; it does not establish current investor ownership or vacancy. No MC records inspected.
original_case.comp: Brickz reports 18 mixed transactions in May 2025-April 2026; a visible 689-sf/3-room RM364k row cannot be treated as an exact 680-sf studio match.
original_case.reversal: At assumed costs the low-rent case fails monthly coverage; even base coverage can coexist with negative annual carry. A small charge or net-rent difference can reverse the lead.
original_case.next: Resolve approved room/area and bay rights; obtain ordinary leases near RM2k and charges; test a matched compact transfer and current competing inventory. Reopen priority only if this changes the financial or exit burden.

original_case.evidence_dates: 30 September 2026 sale index; 10 September same-size rental index

original_case.mechanism: Older useful family space can compete with a newer premium one-bedroom at lower capital cost; renovation and major works may consume the apparent income advantage.
original_case.buyer: Family tenancy/ownership plus income-led resale are plausible, not measured. Compare OOAK compact, other mature Mont Kiara family stock and newly delivered Allevia by task.

original_case.comp: A visible1292-sf700k April2026 transaction differs from1268sf; mixed19-record median is not a reference interval.
original_case.reversal: At3200rent or higher charges the income lead weakens. A fully renovated premium rent cannot be combined with the cheapest unrefurbished purchase.
original_case.next: Identify actual sale condition and fit-out/works budget, confirm matched ordinary3800leases and fees, normalise family transfers and test realistic school/work journeys.
